title: Executable Schema Contracts: From Automatic Ingestion to Multi-Source Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2606.05415v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Real-world data spans tables, documents, and semi-structured files with implicit semantics. Querying this data requires integrating evidence across inconsistent schemas and formats, yet existing approaches either demand costly manual engineering or bypass structure entirely. We present a system that automatically discovers an executable schema from raw multi-source data and uses it as a shared contract for knowledge graph construction and query-time retrieval. A closed-world field catalog constrains LLM-based schema discovery to attested fields; deterministic structural analysis infers identity keys, foreign keys, and source hierarchy; and the resulting schema drives extraction, deduplication, and cross-source linking into a provenance-aware knowledge graph. translated_title: 可执行模式契约：从自动数据摄取到多源检索
translated_abstract: 现实世界的数据涵盖具有隐式语义的表格、文档和半结构化文件。查询这些数据需要在不一致的模式和格式之间整合证据，然而现有方法要么需要昂贵的手工工程，要么完全绕过结构。我们提出了一个系统，它能够从原始多源数据中自动发现可执行模式，并将其用作知识图谱构建和查询时检索的共享契约。封闭世界字段目录将基于大语言模型的模式发现约束到已证实的字段；确定性结构分析推断主键、外键和源层级关系；所得模式驱动信息抽取、去重和跨源链接，从而构建具有来源感知的知识图谱。在查询时，该模式——可通过单调协议选择性地进行扩展——调节多工具代理在结构化查找、图遍历等检索方式之间的路由。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个从原始多源数据中自动发现可执行模式契约的系统，该契约既驱动构建具有来源感知的知识图谱，又在查询时指导多工具代理进行跨结构化查找与图遍历的检索路由。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a system that automatically discovers an executable schema from raw multi-source data as a shared contract, which drives provenance-aware knowledge graph construction and conditions a multi-tool agent's retrieval routing across structured lookup and graph traversal at query time.
